business_problem: Penske needed to help its software engineering teams deliver quality code faster, reduce repetitive work, and modernize older applications without overloading lead developers.
solution_summary: Penske Transportation Solutions used GitHub Copilot in a structured software-engineering pilot designed with Capgemini to improve delivery speed, code quality, and developer leverage. Capgemini helped define the pilot roadmap, measurement framework, and training program for onshore and offshore teams, then supported rollout across three custom software projects. Copilot was introduced as an AI assistant for writing code, reducing repetitive boilerplate and glue-code work, helping junior developers work more independently, and supporting the modernization of older code bases. Penske treated the effort as both a tooling and change-management program, so developers were trained to use Copilot as a productivity and learning aid rather than just an autocomplete feature. After early success, the company began rolling the tool out more broadly across software engineering, where teams continue to find new uses in refactoring, upgrades, and faster feature delivery.
